scope: All848unblindeddevelopment cases; grouped cross-validation is diagnostic, not a new untouched test. No app or public research edits.
training_runs: Exactly two prespecified configurations, each five CV training folds plus one full-data descriptive fit; no configuration selection or other parameter search.
grouping: Union cases by whole game or identical normalized four-field before-position; assign whole union to SHA256(mute-semantic-tree-v5-v1|sorted-case-keys)%5. Both windows stay together.
window_training: Eligible complete current/prior windows, with equal total weight per case; negative cases cost5, positive cases cost1. At least15distinct cases in every leaf.
final_award: Both window trees positive, both original raw-offer/two-root/quality<=5/after-floor>=-100 eligibility masks and existing confidence compatibility pass.
missing: Null is never zero. Add explicit missing indicators; numeric missing values take the documented left branch. Unknown proof states remain explicit.

physical_panel_extension.purpose: Avoid a feature-missing flag that trivially identifies panel membership.

operating_points.default: Positive weighted leaf support exceeds negative support, with fixed5cost on negative cases.
operating_points.strict98: Raw/unweighted positive window fraction>=0.98; prespecified by parent before first fit. Not calibrated population precision.
